name: Melbourne Access Bachelor of Arts Scholarship
summary: A $10,000 yearly allowance for Access Melbourne Arts students from financially disadvantaged or rural backgrounds.
key: $10,000 a year, up to $30,000, about 4 offered.
who: Completed Year 12 or IB in Australia and meets Access Melbourne entry requirements.
Disadvantaged financial background and/or living in a rural or isolated area.
how: Automatic consideration when you apply for admission and submit a VTAC Equity Schemes and scholarships application.

source.label: University of Melbourne: Melbourne Access Bachelor of Arts Scholarship

evidence.quote: An allowance of $10,000 per year for the duration of a Bachelor of Arts degree.
